lines.text: A man in a bowler hat sold the Brooklyn Bridge.
He walked his buyer onto the steel and said,
It's yours for a thousand dollars.
George even built a toll booth and collected fares from real traffic.
When the police arrived, he was already downtown, selling the Statue of Liberty.
Each time, he straightened his hat and found a new buyer.
If you believe that, he had a bridge to sell you.
Oddly, the bridge is still there.
